name: WS::Swift Market Intel::market-intel-analysis

parameters.query: WITH ins AS (INSERT INTO extension_ingest_log (id, aid, source, payload, status) SELECT gen_random_uuid(), $1::uuid, $2::varchar, $3::jsonb, 'executed' WHERE $4::boolean AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM extension_ingest_log WHERE aid = $1::uuid AND source = $2::varchar AND created_at > now() - interval '5 minutes' AND payload->'request'->>'url' = $5::varchar) RETURNING id) SELECT (SELECT id FROM ins) AS ingest_id, (SELECT count(*) FROM ins) AS inserted

notes: Target of the shipped Swift Market Intel extension (workflow_id 'market-intel-analysis'). Contract: POST {aid, triggered_by, payload, webhook_data} -> 200 {status:'executed', ingest_id, analysis{...}} ; 400 {status:'rejected', error} when aid is not a UUID. Writes one aid-scoped row into extension_ingest_log through the least-privilege role n8n_market_intel (INSERT+SELECT on that table only). Authored by kanban t_dd19dc40.
